backup_device_uuid.description: UUID of the backup device to use for snapshots.

parent_device_uuid.description: UUID of the parent device for Btrfs send/receive operations.

do_first_run.description: Whether to run the first-time setup wizard.

stop_cron_emails.description: Stop cron emails during snapshot creation.

count_monthly.description: Number of monthly snapshots to keep.

count_weekly.description: Number of weekly snapshots to keep.

count_daily.description: Number of daily snapshots to keep.

count_hourly.description: Number of hourly snapshots to keep.

count_boot.description: Number of boot snapshots to keep.

snapshot_size.description: Maximum size of a single snapshot in MB. 0 means unlimited.

snapshot_count.description: Maximum number of snapshots to keep. 0 means unlimited.

exclude.description: List of paths or patterns to exclude from snapshots.

exclude-apps.description: List of application names to exclude from snapshots.
